caveats: ⚑ TASTE STATE IS A MODE, NOT A TRIGGER. The engine has no 'gained a buff of flavor X' trigger, so Lingering Taste / Recommended Taste are modeled as selectable modes (default lingeringTaste). Real gating is team-dependent: an ally sustained-damage buff -> Lingering (priority), an ally distributed-damage buff with no sustained -> Recommended. A THIRD real state exists that this model cannot express: a team giving NEITHER flavor leaves her with NO taste, which makes all of skill2 and burst blocks 2-3 inert and removes the charge-speed penalty. On a generic ATK/Attack-Damage support comp that no-taste state is the likely truth.

⚑ Damage-bearing effects (dot, flatDamage) are authored with target self because resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [] in this engine; only the damageTakenPct boss debuff uses target enemy. If the engine instead routes damage effects through an enemy-targeted block, move them.

⚑ 'Aftertaste Effect ▲ 349.8%' is mapped to sustainedDamagePct (Damage Up bucket, additive). This WIDENS scope from 'the Aftertaste DoT' to 'all sustained damage'; damage-equivalent here only because the skill2 Aftertaste DoT is her sole sustained-damage source and the buff is self-scoped. If she ever co-exists with another self sustained source, this over-credits.

⚑ DoT append-not-refresh: each 3-full-charge proc appends an independent 5s / 1s-tick instance. With the -20% charge-speed penalty plus reloads the proc interval is likely >= 5s, so overlap should be small — but the proc rate rides entirely on the unverified cadence tuple.
Mutual exclusion ('Cancels Recommended/Lingering Taste') is implemented structurally by the mode gate (exactly one mode active), not by a cancel effect.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only (no override/test/board access). Structure: skill1 = a team-FB ATK buff + the Taste status toggle (charge-speed self-debuff, identical -20% in either taste, modeled as a mode-gated passive); skill2 splits by taste — Lingering = every-3-full-charges boss Damage Taken debuff + a 150.04%/s sustained Aftertaste DoT; Recommended = per-full-charge self Attack Damage buff + a 265.07% distributed rider; burst = an unconditional Attack Damage buff plus one taste-gated branch each (Aftertaste amplification vs ATK). Charge Speed ▼20% is modeled as a real weapon-state (shot-count) modifier per the kit-parse hard rule, not skipped as defensive. FB-by-timing left ON everywhere (no noFb set); no core on the distributed rider (kit says nothing about core strikes); crit ON for the rider per the flat-damage-rider crit rule. Cadence (ammo 6 / chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141) is datamined and drives the every-3-charge proc rate — it is the single largest source of error in this baseline.

flags.reasoning: The kit gates her entire skill2 and two of three burst branches on a status acquired from ALLY buff flavor, which the engine has no trigger for. Lingering is defaulted because the burst's headline amplification (349.8%) and the Aftertaste DoT both key on it. The real no-taste state (team supplies neither flavor) is not representable and would zero most of the kit.
flags.recipe: Record two fights: (a) with a sustained-damage-buff ally, (b) with a distributed-damage-buff ally, (c) with a plain ATK-only support core. Check for the Aftertaste DoT ticks and the charge-speed change in (c) to confirm whether a no-taste state really occurs; if it does, add a third 'noTaste' mode and pick the default from the intended comp.

flags.estimate: 1.0 s base full charge -> 1.25 s under the -20% Charge Speed penalty; ~2.35 s reload every 6 charges
flags.reasoning: Datamine-unreliable fields, and here they are load-bearing twice over: they set how often the chargeCounter:3 Aftertaste proc fires AND how often the Recommended per-charge rider fires. An error here scales her whole output linearly.
flags.recipe: Count full-charge shots and reload gaps in a solo recording over a fixed 60 s window; derive charges/sec with and without the taste penalty and reconcile against ammo 6.

flags.estimate: shotFired as a stand-in for 'hitting a target with Full Charge'
flags.reasoning: No full-charge trigger kind exists. For a charge SR every trigger pull is assumed to be a landed full charge, so shotFired == full-charge hits. If she ever fires uncharged (e.g. under a stun or at fight end) this over-fires.
flags.recipe: Compare the popup count of the 265.07% distributed hit against the counted full-charge shots in the same window; equality confirms the proxy.

flags.estimate: modeled as permanent (passive, no durationSec) instead of the stated 50 s
flags.reasoning: The kit says 50 s and 'cannot be removed', and the acquiring trigger (ally buff gain) recurs every rotation, so it is effectively permanent for a normal fight. Modeling the 50 s literally would require the unmodeled acquisition trigger.
flags.recipe: If a fight can run >50 s with no re-application of the source buff, watch for the charge time snapping back to 1.0 s; if it does, the permanence assumption is wrong.

flags.reasoning: 'Aftertaste Effect ▲' has no matching StatKey. sustainedDamagePct is the nearest flavor-correct bucket and is damage-equivalent while Aftertaste is her only sustained source, but it is ADDITIVE and therefore diluted by other Damage Up buffs — if the real line is a true multiplier on the DoT, this under-credits badly at 349.8%.
flags.recipe: Read Aftertaste tick popups inside vs outside her burst window in a fixed buff state; the observed ratio distinguishes additive-in-bucket from a standalone multiplier.

flags.estimate: crit true, noFb unset (FB by timing), core absent
flags.reasoning: Per the rider rules: flat-damage riders crit at the caster's sheet rate, take the +50% FB major by landing timing, and get no core unless the text says 'core strike damage' (it does not). All three are convention, not measured for this unit.
flags.recipe: Read the 265.07% popups for orange/crit colouring and compare in-FB vs out-of-FB magnitudes at a fixed ATK to confirm the FB major applies.

flags.estimate: damageTakenPct on target enemy; dot + flatDamage on target self
flags.reasoning: The schema states resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns an empty set, so damage effects authored against enemy risk being silently dropped, while boss debuffs are documented to route through an enemy-targeted block.
flags.recipe: Run the override and assert a damage event with the sustained bucket appears; if zero Aftertaste damage is emitted, flip the block target.
